import ast
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('glp')
source = (root / 'servers/peoplesweb/tools/build.py').read_text()
tree = ast.parse(source)
needed = {'read', 'names_in', 'extends_of'}
nodes = [n for n in tree.body if
    (isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in needed) or
    (isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id == 'RELATIONS')]
env = {'os': os, 're': re, 'NAMEID': {'Auction': 'Auction', 'Second-Score Auction': 'Second-Score-Auction'}, 'NAMES_RE': [None]}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), '<pinned build helpers>', 'exec'), env)
line = next(l.strip() for l in source.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith("c['parametric'] ="))
contracts = []
for name in ('Ads', 'Auction', 'Networked-Organisation', 'Second-Score-Auction', 'Missing'):
    c = {'id': name, 'parametric': None, 'extends': []}
    env.update(c=c, mf=str(root / 'cascade' / name / 'manifest.md'))
    exec(line, env)
    assert c['parametric'] == (name in ('Ads','Auction','Networked-Organisation')), c
    if name == 'Second-Score-Auction':
        text = (root / 'programs/lbm/Second-Score-Auction.txt').read_text()
        c['name'] = 'Second-Score Auction'
        c['meta'] = []
        c['extends'] = env['extends_of'](c, text.splitlines())
        assert c['extends'] == ['Auction'] and c['rels']['Auction'] == 'instantiates', c
    contracts.append(c)
Path('contracts.json').write_text(json.dumps(contracts))
print('Manifest classification: three parametric positives, concrete and missing-manifest controls; Auction instance relation confirmed.')
